question: Where are a nature reserve found within 160 kilometers when heading north from Park Hyatt New York, New York, NY?
sql: WITH origin_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Park Hyatt New York%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name AS name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, origin_point op WHERE p.leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, op.geometry::geography, 160000) AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(op.geometry, p.geometry)) >= 337.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(op.geometry, p.geometry)) <= 22.5 ) UNION ALL SELECT pk.park_name AS name, NULL AS addr_city, -- parks table does not have address columns NULL AS addr_state -- parks table does not have address columns FROM parks pk, origin_point op WHERE pk.leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(pk.geometry::geography, op.geometry::geography, 160000) AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(op.geometry, pk.geometry)) >= 337.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(op.geometry, pk.geometry)) <= 22.5 );

metadata.final_exec_err: ST_Azimuth(geography, geography) is only valid for point inputs
